title: Weak illusionism collapses into strong illusionism without a stronger notion of the phenomenal

statements.text: If weak illusionism is not to collapse into strong illusionism, it needs a concept of phenomenality stronger than quasi-phenomenality yet weak enough to yield to conservative explanation. Frankish doubts such a concept exists, in which case radical realism and strong illusionism are the only options.
